requirements.description: Review exact variant, programmable limits, capacitor effective values and terminal ratings; OUT negative excursions and IN-OUT differential need explicit bounds.
Qualify all copper neckdowns, contacts and thermal paths for full-load and fault currents; after-device capacitors have unprotected stored energy.
Review package-local RPW copper and stencil, short power/return loops, local bypass, output clamp, ILM parasitics and noise isolation against section8.4. No physical macro is supplied.

Review start/stop, overload, hard-short and reverse-current transients with actual inductance. Typical fast-trip delay is not a guaranteed bound. FLT is not power-good and does not latch every initial fast trip.
Measure startup, fault/recovery waveforms, peak current, terminal overshoot and temperature across the intended envelope before approval.

notes: Standalone exact part; no qualified circuit or hard macro. Source-derived footprint and facts do not establish short-circuit survival or automatic-retry safety.
